headline: Desai & Diwanji acts on Anchor Offshore Services DRHP filing

detail: Anchor Offshore Services Limited has filed a Draft Red Herring Prospectus for an initial public offering comprising a fresh issue of up to 64,00,000 equity shares of face value ₹ 10 each by the Company and an offer for sale by Promoter Selling Shareholder of up to 6,00,000 equity shares of face value ₹ 10 each. Desai & Diwanji advised Anchor Offshore Services on this DRHP filing. The transaction team consisted of Tushar Dey (Senior Partner), Akshay Bhagchandani (Partner), Associates Ankit Rao, Mahimna Dave, Ankit Singh, Divam Garg, Paritosh Srivastava, Jay Sanvaliya, Gouriyanka Sharma, and Trainee Associate Shilpi Sharma.
